observations: Used car engine removed from a vehicle, sitting on concrete ground
Black plastic engine cover with multiple hoses, wires, and mechanical components attached
No readable brand badge, model plate, or VIN visible on the engine
Brake disc or hub assembly visible in background top left
Watermark 'T.I AUTOMOBILE' across the center of the image
Engine appears complete with ancillaries but condition cannot be confirmed from still photos

claims.evidence: Photos show a used engine but cannot confirm foreign-used/tokunbo status or direct import origin

risks.risk: Engine does not run or has no compression
risks.proof: Video of the engine starting and running, or compression test results

risks.risk: Internal mechanical damage not visible externally
risks.proof: Borescope inspection video or teardown photos showing internal condition

risks.risk: Missing ancillaries such as ECU, harness, manifolds, or sensors
risks.proof: Itemized photo showing every component included in the sale
Service records, import documents, or verifiable mileage evidence

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running
Compression test results or borescope inspection video
Itemized photo of all included parts and ancillaries
Import or shipping documents to support tokunbo claim
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a used car engine, so it can be priced at its worst case (non-running) even though the exact brand and model cannot be read from the photo.
